rows.text: compares byte `rdx+0x18` with 1: when it equals 1 it returns 0 in `eax`; otherwise it tail-jumps (at `00265380` + 0x9) with the incoming registers unchanged

returns 1 when qword `0209BE80` is null or when bit `0x20` of its dword `+0x10F68` is set; otherwise walks the chain from qword `+0x10F10` through each node's qword `+0x868` to the first node whose dword `+0x810` equals `ecx` and, when one is found, copies bit `0x100` of that node's word `+0x842` (shifted right 3) into bit `0x20` of dword `+0x10F68`, leaving its other bits unchanged; on that path and when the chain is empty or has no match it returns bit 5 of dword `+0x10F68` as 0 or 1

notes: 00290840: after the store the global qword `0209BE80` is re-read before the final read of `+0x10F68`. On the chain-empty path the returned bit is necessarily 0 because bit 0x20 was tested clear just before; the sentence states it as the bit read. No doubts.
